submission.natural_language_explanation: This negative pole is a context-free L0 unigram detector: its strength is fixed by the current token's embedding alone, saturating at the GELU floor (~0.17) for a fixed vocabulary subset (e.g. simple, saying, indirect, woman, red, dog, mid-word dd/ed) while staying near zero on function tokens (the, of, that), most punctuation, and many content words (green, house, thing, rule, child); changing the current token swings strength, changing only surrounding context leaves it unchanged.
